turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in class. Who decided that?

I have six things. One, the version history: created October 28 at 11:31 PM, 612 words at 11:52, 794 at 11:58, no earlier drafts. Two, the essay quotes a line from Act 3, Scene 2 that is not in Hamlet. Three, his October 15 outline argued cowardice; the essay never mentions it. Four, on November 2 he could not tell me what epistemological paralysis means. Five, his in-class writing on September 24 was 380 words with comma splices and no quotations. Six, the checker said 94 percent.

Number six is a machine's guess, and the people who sell these tools say they shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing anyone. Put that Act 3, Scene 2 line in front of me, on paper, with the play open beside it. And you still haven't told me who entered that zero before anyone called me.
Which of those do you want to see first?
I just told you: the line, and the play. Then who decided.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology, that I be shown the Act 3, Scene 2 line on paper beside the play, and that I be told who entered the zero before anyone contacted me. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed in her opening position and agreed to nothing. She still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, the Act 3, Scene 2 line shown to her beside the play, and an answer on who entered the zero before anyone called home. The fair outcome would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting ended before you reached it.
What moved her: Nothing, because you listed six pieces of evidence but put none of them in front of her to check.
What cost ground: You opened with all six at once, including the checker score, and skipped her first question about the zero being entered before anyone called home, so she attacked your weakest point and stayed fixed on procedure.
What she never said: One night in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your version history, with the file created at 11:31 PM on October 28, the night before it was due, came very close to that kind of night. It proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked who decided on the zero, own the call home in one sentence, then hand her the misquoted Act 3, Scene 2 line next to the play and let her check it before you mention anything else.
